verdict.rationale: Shopify's authentication docs state that code obtains an access token scoped to the permissions it needs, and that access scopes determine what an app can access. This directly supports least-privilege credentials that an agent can use, and the agent docs describe agents that authenticate and securely act on behalf of buyers via UCP. missing for 10: an agent-specific credential issuance flow, detail on the scope list and granularity, token revocation or expiry controls, and independent hands-on corroboration.
